description.en: Translate into what people in a specific country actually say — not a literal gloss. 249 countries, live FX, back-translation check.
description.zh: 按目标国家做本地化翻译：翻成当地人真正会说的那句话，附实时汇率与反向翻译自检。249 个国家/地区。

pluginDescription.en: Pick a country, paste Chinese, get the expression locals actually use. Plus live exchange-rate conversion and a back-translation check.
pluginDescription.zh: 选一个国家，粘中文，得到当地人日常会说的表达。附实时汇率换算与反向翻译自检。
